versions.changelog:
Initial release of trollbridge-x402-intel: pay-per-call crypto intel API

- Offers 100 live API endpoints (lanes) covering markets data, token safety, scam detection, Polymarket odds, and DeFi yields.
- Pay per call in USDC on Base (or Solana) using the x402 standard; receive price quote and payment details via HTTP 402.
- No API keys or signup required; payment is handled by x402 clients or manually via wallet.
- Endpoints are tiered by price ($0.02–$30.00); free /health and /tools endpoints for liveness and discovery.
- Readable SKILL.md with usage instructions, example calls, pricing, and honest caveats.
